quote: Entire pancake range is 米粉100% (100% rice flour); no wheat flour or wheat pasta is used on the premises, so batter-level cross-contact is inherently low. However no formal celiac cross-contact protocol is published.
found: 100％米粉を使った、ふわふわのパンケーキが自慢のカフェ。
note: CONTRADICTED, safety-critical: the cited page only supports '100% rice flour pancakes'. The venue's own site (archived) states 「※パスタは小麦とバターを使用しています。ご希望の方は、グルテンフリーのライスパスタへ変更可能です。」 — wheat pasta IS cooked on the premises, and blog.nagano-ken.jp (cited elsewhere in this same record) says 「サラダや平日限定のパスタなどもあります」. Delete the 'no wheat flour or wheat pasta on the premises' clause and re-rate cross-contact as shared-kitchen.

quote: Savory pancakes such as ハーブ鶏の照り焼き (herb-chicken teriyaki, described as 甘じょっぱい / sweet-salty) and the Shinshu salmon plate use teriyaki/soy-based sauces that are wheat unless tamari — a celiac should confirm the sauce or choose the sweet pancakes.
found: 【ハーブ鶏の照り焼き】甘じょっぱくてとても美味しかったです！
note: Teriyaki + 甘じょっぱい verbatim. The Shinshu-salmon half is not on this page — the venue's own site carries it (「ふわふわ信州サーモン … 当店秘伝の醤油で召し上がれ」, https://web.archive.org/web/20251016212535/https://cafe-fuwafuwa.com/); add that URL if the salmon clause is kept.

quote: Whipped cream is soy-milk based (dairy-free) but pancake batter contains free-range egg, so pancakes are not vegan.
found: 【豆乳ホイップ】牛乳不使用 … 【鶏卵】会田共同養鶏組合さん 松本市四賀地区にて遺伝子組み換えでない飼料を与えられて育った平飼い鶏の卵を使用しています。
note: Cited komachi page only says 「オーガニック豆乳や平飼いたまごなど…使用」 — it never ties soy milk to the whipped cream. echohall.jp (already cited elsewhere in this record) states it explicitly. Repoint. Also note the venue site adds 「※アイスは牛乳使用です」 — the ice cream topping is dairy.

quote: No published allergy/celiac handling protocol found; the shop markets 'gluten-free pancakes' but is not a certified celiac kitchen. Communicate celiac disease directly at ordering.
found: (archived 2025-10-16) 「日本では珍しいグルテンフリーのふわふわパンケーキをご提供してます。」「グルテンフリーなので、年配の方や、お子様などすべての方々に安心して食べていただけます。」 — no allergy/celiac protocol anywhere on the site.
note: The record's own website URL is DOWN (526) and the site's stated HP fuwafuwa-pancake.com is NXDOMAIN — check trading status before shipping. Absence-claim itself holds on the archived copy.

quote: Concept is 100% rice flour with no wheat flour on premises, plus reduced sugar, soy-milk cream, organic local produce and Nagano red sorghum — a genuinely rice-flour-first kitchen, unusual on the Hakuba route.
found: 【米粉】グルテンフリー … 【豆乳ホイップ】牛乳不使用 … 【砂糖】カロリーオフ … パンケーキは、米粉100%使用と砂糖を減らすことにより…
note: echohall supports rice flour / reduced sugar / soy-milk cream but says nothing about red sorghum or organic produce (those are on the venue site: 「厳選米粉・長野県産赤ソルガム粉を使ったふわふわパンケーキ」). And 'no wheat flour on premises' is false — same site sells wheat pasta. Also geographically wrong: this cafe is in Omachi city (文化会館 サン･アルプス大町), not on the Hakuba route.

quote: Shop makes both 米粉 (wheat-free) and 小麦粉 (wheat) donuts in the same small kitchen; no dedicated GF fryer or line is stated by the venue, so cross-contact is plausible.
found: 常時10種類ほどのドーナツは店内で製造。坂城町にある自社農園産の米粉や小麦粉を使い、甘さは控え、食べやすく仕上げている。
note: Both flours, made in-store, shop floor ~9坪 (「店舗面積は約9坪」) — supports 'same small kitchen'. No fryer/line separation mentioned anywhere on the page, so the 'no dedicated GF fryer stated' half is a true absence.

quote: GF blogger warns: 「それ以外のドーナツは小麦を使用していますので、アレルギー表示を必ずご確認ください」 (other donuts use wheat — always check the allergen label) and does not confirm dedicated equipment.
found: 米粉のオールドファッションドーナツを購入できます。それ以外のドーナツは小麦を使用していますので、アレルギー表示を必ずご確認ください。
note: Quote verbatim. Worth flagging in the record: the blogger lists Hibi Donut under 「まだまだある」 (「今回は立ち寄ることができなかった」) — she did NOT visit, so this is second-hand, not an eyewitness report.

quote: No published allergen-handling protocol; blogger advises confirming allergen labels in person. Ask directly about separate frying oil for the 米粉 donuts.
found: それ以外のドーナツは小麦を使用していますので、アレルギー表示を必ずご確認ください。
note: Supported as an absence claim; the 'ask about separate frying oil' line is the record's own advice, not on the page (fine as advice, but it is not sourced).

quote: The 米粉 old-fashioned donuts are made with in-house-milled rice flour and are described as 小麦粉不使用 (wheat-flour-free).
found: サクっとした食感が魅力の米粉のオールドファッションは、全て小麦粉不使用。／自社ファームで栽培するお米から作った米粉と小麦粉を使った米粉オールドファッション…
note: 小麦粉不使用 verbatim, and correct branch (松本中町店). 'in-house-milled' overstates slightly — the page says the rice is grown on their own farm (自社ファーム) and made into rice flour; milling location is not stated.
